scripts.gen-types:production: dotenv -e environments/.env.production.local -e environments/.env.karlsruhe.local -- npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" --schema public,games,audit,notifications,util > src/types/supabase-generated.types.ts
scripts.gen-types:staging: dotenv -e environments/.env.staging.local -- npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" --schema public,games,audit,notifications,util > src/types/supabase-generated.types.ts
scripts.gen-types:local: npx supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public,games,audit,notifications,util > src/types/supabase-generated.types.ts && cp src/types/supabase-generated.types.ts supabase/functions/_shared
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org roundnet-karlsruhe --project roundnet-karlsruhe ./build && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org roundnet-karlsruhe --project roundnet-karlsruhe ./build
scripts.supabase:db:push:staging: dotenv -e environments/.env.staging.local -- npx supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" && npx supabase db push --linked
scripts.supabase:db:push:rk:prod: dotenv -e environments/.env.production.local -e environments/.env.karlsruhe.local -- npx supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" && npx supabase db push
scripts.supabase:db:push:mrc:prod: dotenv -e environments/.env.production.local -e environments/.env.munich.local -- npx supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" && npx supabase db push
scripts.supabase:func:deploy:prod: dotenv -e environments/.env.production.local -e environments/.env.munich.local -- supabase functions deploy --project-ref "$VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" && dotenv -e environments/.env.production.local -e environments/.env.karlsruhe.local -- supabase functions deploy --project-ref "$VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID"
